record.field: SELECT a.aufnr, a.auart, p.matnr, a.werks, k.gamng, p.meins, k.gmein, k.gstrp, k.gltrp, a.ernam, a.erdat, marm.umrez, marm.umren, 'NOT TECO' AS teco_status, a.loekz, s.rspos, s.matnr AS component, s.bdmng, s.meins AS uom_comp FROM aufk a LEFT JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr LEFT JOIN afpo p ON a.mandt = p.mandt AND a.aufnr = p.aufnr LEFT JOIN marm ON marm.mandt = p.mandt AND marm.matnr = p.matnr AND marm.meinh = k.gmein LEFT JOIN resb s ON a.mandt = s.mandt AND k.rsnum = s.rsnum WHERE a.autyp = '10' AND a.erdat BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE),'YYYYMMDD')
